n = int(input())
s = input()

underscoreCount = 0
maxSegment = 0
lastIndex = -1
inParentheses = False

for i, ch in enumerate(s):
    if ch == '_':
        if lastIndex != i - 1:
            if inParentheses:
                underscoreCount += 1
            else:
                maxSegment = max(maxSegment, i - 1 - lastIndex)
        lastIndex = i
    elif ch == '(':
        inParentheses = True
        if lastIndex != i - 1:
            maxSegment = max(maxSegment, i - 1 - lastIndex)
        lastIndex = i
    elif ch == ')':
        inParentheses = False
        if lastIndex != i - 1:
            underscoreCount += 1
        lastIndex = i

if lastIndex != len(s) - 1:
    maxSegment = max(maxSegment, len(s) - 1 - lastIndex)

print(f"{maxSegment} {underscoreCount}")
